CompareOut.title: CompareOut

ConstraintsDelta.description: What a message changes, normalised: lists always present, numbers unset or >= 0.
ConstraintsDelta.title: ConstraintsDelta

demographics.description: Aggregate audience demographics as returned by audience_demographics.
demographics.title: Demographics

notes.description: Why the profile is less than complete: skipped acts, non-ok envelope summaries.
notes.title: Notes

address.description: Street address Qloo gives for a place, so same-named venues can be told apart.
address.title: Address

call_id.description: call_id of the Qloo call (uuid) recorded by the gateway.
call_id.title: Call Id

item_ref.description: Which item this evidence supports, e.g. 'genres[0]' or an entity ID.
item_ref.title: Item Ref

Refinement.description:
How a refined run came to be: the booker's message, the delta read from it (as
applied) and the explanation of what changed against the parent run.
Refinement.title: Refinement

RunResult.description:
The agent's final JSON as stored: `shortlist` for an ok run, `ask` when a tool
needed the user, `error` when the run failed.
RunResult.title: RunResult

SeedPageOut.description: One seed's page, as `GET /seeds/{slug}/page` serves it.
SeedPageOut.title: SeedPageOut

ShortlistEntry.description:
One ranked act, in `score_and_rank`'s order. The score fields come from the stored
candidate; `reason` is the agent's own (templated for the top five, else the model's).
ShortlistEntry.title: ShortlistEntry

SupportPick.description: The support pick and the call behind it; `act` None when there is none to suggest.
SupportPick.title: SupportPick

post.description:
One agent run. 503 `live_mode_off` with `LIVE_MODE=off` and 429 `budget` at either
daily cap, both before anything is stored and both naming `fallback_seed`.

get.description: The run's Qloo calls in order, as recorded (the API key already redacted).

schema.title: Response Get Calls Runs  Run Id  Calls Get

patch.description:
Pencil (or release) a hold on the candidate; idempotent. 404 when unknown, 403 on a
seed run (read-only).

get.description:
The LLM-only shortlist for the run's venue and constraints: one tool-less Haiku 5.5
call the first time, then the copy cached on the run (no tokens spent).

post.description:
A new run under the parent's constraints changed as the message asks.

404 for an unknown parent; 422 when no change can be read from the message (nothing is
spent on Qloo then); 429 at either daily cap. The parse is one model call, the re-run a
normal agent run with every cap of `POST /runs`, and refused like one with `LIVE_MODE=off`.

get.description: Every seed in file order with its precompute state; ETag over the whole list.
The whole seed page in one read; 404 unknown slug, 409 not precomputed.

post.description: Create a venue, or update one by `id`; an update drops stale resolutions and profile.
Build and store the crowd profile; 409 while any item is unresolved or unconfirmed.
Resolve the venue and each past act not resolved yet (stored items are not re-asked).
